items.hed: Astros are out; Cleveland hosts Tampa Bay in Game 3 today at 1 p.m. Eastern
items.insight: MLB.com's postseason schedule lists the Dodgers, Brewers, Rays, and Guardians in the League Championship Series. Houston is not on that list. Thursday's Game 3, Tampa Bay at Cleveland, is at 1 p.m. Eastern on TBS, truTV, HBO Max, and UniMas. The original 6 p.m. start was moved because of a forecast of inclement weather. Milwaukee at Los Angeles, Game 4, is at 8 p.m. Eastern.
